title: Lecturer on Law
bio: Jordi Weinstock is the Senior Advisor to Harvard’s Berkman Klein Center for Internet and Society. He has served as a Lecturer at Harvard Law School in Debates on Frontier Artificial Intelligence Governance: the AI Triad, Agentic Artificial Intelligence and the Law, Internet & Society: the Technologies and Politics of Control, Medical Artificial Intelligence: Ethics, Law, […]
research_interests: Cyber Law and Policy and the Internet Health
